verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly exposes a CLI, REST API tokens, and an MCP server that could be scripted by an AI-native user to act on many flags/segments programmatically, but no documented UI or API feature explicitly named 'bulk operations' (e.g., bulk edit/bulk archive across flags) appears in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-update API endpoints or UI, documentation of batch operations across contexts/segments, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale usage.
